items.definition:
arranged in the order of the letters of the alphabet
Please list the names in alphabetical order.

not friendly
The new neighbor seemed very unfriendly.

pleased because you have got what you wanted
She felt satisfied with her performance.

more liquid than usual; flowing
I have a runny nose today.

occupying the whole of someone's usual working time
He works as a full-time software engineer.

between 13 and 19 years old
She has two teenaged children.

not cooked
The chicken was still uncooked in the middle.

insane; very angry
He got even madder when he heard the news.
